name: Helpless Cheetah 32
author: Cornerstone-04
description: Neon gradient green button that glows on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, text color changes from #fff to #000, box-shadow becomes 0 0 10px #0f0,
                0 0 20px #0f0,
                0 0 40px #0f0, 
                0 0 80px #0f0, 
                0 0 100px #0f0, width becomes 60%.
